Pune is India's densest auto and manufacturing corridor. The MIDC belt around the city — Chakan, Talegaon, Ranjangaon, and the Pimpri-Chinchwad industrial zone — packs together vehicle manufacturers, Tier-1 and Tier-2 component suppliers, engineering firms, and the logistics operations that feed them. It is one of the most concentrated industrial regions in the country, and it builds constantly. Every plant expansion, every new supplier setup, every construction project needs a site office, a security cabin, or an administrative unit on the ground fast.

SAMAN manufactures steel container offices and supplies them across Pune. We build at our facility in Greater Noida and dispatch to your Pune site. We are honest about logistics: Pune is roughly 1,400 kilometres from our factory, so we plan the dispatch around your project schedule rather than promising next-day delivery. What you get is a unit built to a certified quality standard, with real documentation behind it — not a refurbished container of unknown origin from a local reseller.

Explore container office sizes and build options or call us to discuss your requirement and timeline.

Who Buys a Container Office in Pune's MIDC Corridor

A container office is a finished steel workspace — built from a refabricated shipping container or a new container-style steel frame — that arrives wired, insulated, and ready to use. No civil construction, no waiting for a permanent room. In Pune's industrial belt, the buyers are clear:

Auto and component manufacturers in Chakan, Ranjangaon, and Pimpri-Chinchwad use container offices as line supervisor cabins, quality-control rooms, and administrative space during capacity expansion. When a plant adds a line, a container office gives the team a workspace without disrupting production.

Factory expansion and EPC contractors building new units across the MIDC zones need a project manager's site office and a security cabin at the entry. A construction site office cabin for project teams is the standard solution — lockable, weatherproof, and movable when the project shifts.

Logistics and warehousing operators along the Pune-Mumbai corridor and the Talegaon belt place container offices at yard entries for dispatch supervision and gate control.

Growing manufacturing units that need to scale workspace in phases choose a modular shipping container office that scales up — adding units as the operation grows.

Pune's Industrial Zones — Where We Deliver

Telling us your delivery zone lets us plan the route and quote accurate freight. We deliver across the Pune industrial region, including:

Chakan MIDC (PIN 410501): The flagship auto-manufacturing hub north of Pune — home to major vehicle manufacturers and a deep supplier ecosystem. Often called part of the "Detroit of India" auto belt. Plant construction and expansion here drive steady container office demand.

Talegaon MIDC: The industrial zone on the Pune-Mumbai expressway corridor, hosting manufacturing, engineering, and logistics units. Its position on the expressway makes it a logistics-heavy belt where yard offices and security cabins are in regular demand.

Ranjangaon MIDC: The large industrial area east of Pune on the Pune-Ahmednagar road, hosting heavy manufacturing and engineering plants. New unit construction here generates site office requirements.

Pimpri-Chinchwad: The established industrial township adjacent to Pune, one of the oldest and largest manufacturing zones in Maharashtra. Container offices serve as factory cabins, contractor offices, and overflow workspace across this dense belt.

Outside these zones, we deliver to construction and industrial sites across the Pune Metropolitan Region wherever a crane or forklift can place the unit.

Sizes and Specifications

Built to last on a Pune MIDC industrial site.

Structure: Refabricated ISO shipping container OR new IS 2062 grade steel frame, anti-rust treated and painted
Insulation: PUF panel or rock wool lining — keeps the interior workable through Pune's warm summers
Roofing: Container roof with weather sealing, or sloped GI over-roof for monsoon
Flooring: Marine plywood, vinyl, or anti-skid steel
Electrical: Wiring, MCB board, LED lights, fan and AC points to your declared load
Windows: Sliding glass with MS safety grille; mesh ventilation
Doors: Container door retained for storage-office combos, or MS/glass entry door

Common sizes for Pune delivery:

SizeTypical use
10 ftSecurity cabin or single-desk office
20 ftStandard site office — most common
40 ftLarge office, or office + storage combination
20 ft + partitionOffice plus QC or meeting room
40 ft modularJoined units for larger workspace

Custom layouts and partitions are built to your site footprint.

Customisation — Built at Our Factory Before the Long Dispatch

Everything is built and fitted at our Greater Noida factory before dispatch — so the unit arrives complete and needs no on-site assembly, which matters for a long-haul delivery.

  • Internal partition walls for separate rooms
  • Air conditioner provision — cut-out, bracket, copper sleeve, drain
  • Full electrical fit-out with MCB, sockets, LED, fan points
  • Insulated false ceiling for cooling efficiency
  • Attached toilet module with FRP tank and plumbing
  • Pantry counter for longer-stay site offices
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for outdoor durability
  • Exterior paint and company branding panel

Why Buy From SAMAN

We manufacture our own container offices — most suppliers serving Pune are dealers reselling units with no certification or warranty.

  • ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management (E20250218645)
  • ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management (E20250218646)
  • ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety (E20250218647)
  • NSIC: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
  • DPIIT: DIPP56005
  • GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT

Structural frame warranty: 5 years. Finishing: 1–2 years. Engineered service life: 20–25 years. Over 500 projects since 2009.

Auto-sector and MIDC buyers who need vendor documentation for a quality audit or procurement file can request ISO certificate copies, NSIC registration, and GST papers with the order.

Price Factors

No fixed published price — every container office is built to specification. Cost depends on:

  • Converted shipping container vs new steel-frame build
  • Size (10 ft / 20 ft / 40 ft)
  • Insulation and climate-protection level
  • Electrical and AC fit-out
  • Partition, toilet, and pantry additions
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for long-term outdoor use

Freight from Greater Noida to Pune (about 1,400 km) is quoted as a separate, transparent line item. For larger or multi-unit orders the per-unit freight is more efficient. Send your size and use for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the price of a container office in Pune?

Price depends on size, whether it is a converted shipping container or a new steel-frame build, the insulation and AC fit-out, and any partition or toilet additions. A basic 20 ft unit costs less than a 40 ft fully-fitted office. Freight from our Greater Noida factory to Pune is added as a separate transparent line. Call +91 87960 39938 for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Can you deliver a container office to Chakan or Ranjangaon MIDC?

Yes. We deliver to Chakan MIDC (PIN 410501), Talegaon MIDC, Ranjangaon MIDC, Pimpri-Chinchwad, and all Pune industrial and construction addresses. For MIDC estate deliveries needing gate-pass authorisation, share the entry procedure when you order and we coordinate the delivery vehicle with your site.

Pune is far from your factory — how do you manage delivery?

Pune is about 1,400 km from our Greater Noida factory, with road transit of several days. We are upfront about this and plan the dispatch around your project schedule, so the unit arrives when you need it on-site rather than as a surprise. The cabin is fully built and fitted before dispatch — nothing is assembled at your site. For a unit that must last years on a MIDC plot, certified build quality and real documentation justify the planned lead time.

Do you provide documentation for an auto-sector vendor audit in Pune?

Yes. We supply ISO certificate copies (9001, 14001, 45001), NSIC registration, DPIIT recognition, and GST registration as part of your order file. If your Tier-1 supplier or plant audit requires a manufacturer's declaration for installed cabins, request it at order stage and we include it with the delivery paperwork.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For a container office in Pune — manufactured by SAMAN, delivered to your MIDC site:

+91 87960 39938 | +91 97089 89937

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. Include your size, use, delivery zone, and project timeline for a complete quotation without a follow-up call.
